source_facts: GET_CABINET_INFO consumes nested book_info by book id and skill id
LEARN_SKILL request is skill_id and response updates cabinet_info
source UI requires owned book item and Cabinet level >= book star
prerequisites must be ahead of current target skill level
cost vectors are target-level/source-cost-family indexed and may contain Skill Page sentinel -1
duration is target-level skill time minus Cabinet cut_time
one active research is exposed by cabinet timer state
SPEED_UP_SKILL returns cabinet_info, book_id and book-specific book_info
compatibility_policies: full Skill Page return only before READY
lazy server materialization of natural timer completion
unknowns: exact original-server ordinary-resource cancellation refund formula
exact original-server persistence/materialization moment when a Cabinet timer naturally expires
architecture_verdict: existing canonical Workshop/UoW/Hero/inventory owners remain appropriate; no redesign required
